bookings_confirmed_consistency_check.name: bookings_confirmed_consistency_check
bookings_confirmed_consistency_check.value: status <> 'confirmed' OR (payment_ref IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

bookings_expired_consistency_check.name: bookings_expired_consistency_check
bookings_expired_consistency_check.value: status <> 'expired' OR expired_at IS NOT NULL

bookings_cancelled_consistency_check.name: bookings_cancelled_consistency_check
bookings_cancelled_consistency_check.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR cancelled_at IS NOT NULL

booking_events_from_status_check.name: booking_events_from_status_check
booking_events_from_status_check.value: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('held', 'payment_pending', 'confirmed', 'expired', 'cancelled')

products_published_location_check.name: products_published_location_check
products_published_location_check.value: status <> 'published' OR location IS NOT NULL

allocations_released_at_consistency_chec.name: allocations_released_at_consistency_check
allocations_released_at_consistency_chec.value: (state = 'active' AND released_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'released' AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

email_messages_sent_at_consistency_check.name: email_messages_sent_at_consistency_check
email_messages_sent_at_consistency_check.value: (status = 'sent' AND sent_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'sent' AND sent_at IS NULL)

payment_attempts_completed_consistency_c.name: payment_attempts_completed_consistency_check
payment_attempts_completed_consistency_c.value: (status = 'initiated' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'initiated' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

refunds_completed_consistency_check.name: refunds_completed_consistency_check
refunds_completed_consistency_check.value: (status = 'succeeded' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'succeeded' AND completed_at IS NULL)

inbox_messages_pending_idx.name: inbox_messages_pending_idx
inbox_messages_pending_idx.where: processed_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL

outbox_events_pending_idx.name: outbox_events_pending_idx
outbox_events_pending_idx.where: published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL

price_list_items_age_check.name: price_list_items_age_check
price_list_items_age_check.value: min_age >= 0 AND (max_age IS NULL OR max_age >= min_age)

price_lists_valid_range_check.name: price_lists_valid_range_check
price_lists_valid_range_check.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from
